discoveredAssets: localhost:5003 - Flask web application (PayMeBack) - Port 5003, Werkzeug 3.1.3, Python 3.13.3
http://localhost:5003/login - Authentication endpoint with HTTP form submission
http://localhost:5003/transactions - Protected endpoint for viewing transactions (302 redirect)
http://localhost:5003/add_transaction - Protected endpoint for creating transactions (302 redirect)
http://localhost:5003/logout - Protected endpoint for logging out (302 redirect)
http://localhost:5003/console - CRITICAL: Werkzeug Interactive Console/Debugger (200 OK, PIN-protected)

targets.objective: Test authentication mechanism for: SQLi/NoSQLi injection in username/password fields, default credentials, authentication bypass, account enumeration via error messages, CSRF attacks, brute force resistance, password validation weaknesses
targets.rationale: Primary authentication endpoint - critical for access to protected functionality. No rate limiting observed on login attempts. Error messages reveal valid/invalid credential discrimination.

targets.objective: Test Werkzeug debugger security: attempt PIN bypass (brute force if possible), test for PIN extraction from environment/logs, evaluate code execution capability if PIN is obtained, check for CSRF vulnerabilities in PIN submission, test debugger resources accessibility
targets.rationale: CRITICAL VULNERABILITY - Werkzeug interactive console exposed with PIN authentication. If PIN can be obtained or bypassed, arbitrary Python code execution is possible. This is the highest priority target.

targets.objective: Test authenticated access: IDOR vulnerabilities (access other users' transactions), business logic flaws in transaction viewing/filtering, data exposure, insufficient authorization checks
targets.rationale: Core functionality page - once authenticated, test for horizontal privilege escalation and unauthorized data access between users.

targets.objective: Test transaction creation: injection vulnerabilities (command injection, template injection), CSRF on transaction creation, business logic flaws (amount manipulation, invalid user selection), authorization bypass, race conditions
targets.rationale: Sensitive functionality - transaction creation likely performs financial operations. Test for manipulation of transaction parameters.

targets.objective: Test redirect behavior: verify if there are bypass methods for the redirect to /login, check for open redirects via referer/next parameters, test for SSRF via redirect parameter
targets.rationale: Application redirects root to login - test for bypass techniques that might skip authentication.

targets.objective: Infrastructure testing: verify service configuration, check for information disclosure in error pages (500 errors show stack traces), test for HTTP header vulnerabilities (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), test for XXE/XXS via form fields, check server banner information
targets.rationale: Full application assessment including infrastructure and HTTP security headers.

keyFindings: [CRITICAL] Werkzeug Interactive Console exposed at /console with PIN authentication - Allows arbitrary Python code execution if PIN is obtained or bypassed. SECRET value exposed: aznnAa6A0JvGr0BKN5DR
[HIGH] Application requires authentication but no public registration endpoint exists - Users must be pre-created, suggesting closed/limited application or administrative user provisioning only
[HIGH] Login endpoint shows detailed error messages ('Invalid credentials, please try again') - Enables username enumeration attacks
[MEDIUM] Werkzeug debugger JavaScript and resources are accessible via ?__debugger__=yes&cmd=resource&f=* parameters
[MEDIUM] Protected endpoints (/transactions, /add_transaction, /logout) require authentication but redirect with next parameter - Potential for open redirect if not properly validated
[MEDIUM] Application sends Set-Cookie with HttpOnly flag - Good security practice for session management
[MEDIUM] No API endpoints found - Application uses traditional HTML form-based routes (no REST API)
[LOW] Extensive testing found only 4 main application endpoints + debug console - Limited attack surface but focused on core functionality
